description:
[Web DOM inspection. Read-only, non-destructive, side-effect free]. Inspects website scripts, widgets, and DOM elements for user-facing generative AI/chatbot interfaces (OpenAI, Anthropic, Intercom Fin, Voiceflow, Botpress) and verifies mandatory Article 50 EU AI Act transparency disclosures.
Usage: Use this tool to evaluate user-facing artificial intelligence systems for statutory transparency compliance under the EU AI Act.
Returns: JSON object with { aiSystemsDetected: string[], hasArticle50Disclosure: boolean, disclosureSnippet: string | null, riskLevel: 'MINIMAL' | 'SPECIFIC_TRANSPARENCY' | 'HIGH', complianceNotes: string[] }.

url.description: Target website URL to inspect (e.g. https://novapixel.it)

name: eu_ai_act_check
